init.title: N-Box Matter options
init.description:
{status}

Leave the node number at 0 to detect the N-Box automatically.

Cooldown period: after a message from an app and sender fired an event, further messages from the same app and sender fire no event for this many seconds. The sensors still update.

Burst window: new messages on one LED that arrive closer together than this are collapsed into the last one. A safety net against flooding; leave it at 0 if your announcement queue handles it.
